contrasts.name: Known must-have break sorts below several big gaps
A one-notch must-have break sorts below a single big gap and a split must-have
contrasts.default_at_stake: must-have break sorts last, however small the break

contrasts.name: A gap inside stated tolerance costs nothing
Many small gaps versus one big gap
contrasts.default_at_stake: linear excess per trait, summed (no 'nothing quite fits' term)

contrasts.name: Same gap sizes, tolerated versus untolerated direction
Split evidence with both ends inside tolerance costs nothing
contrasts.default_at_stake: mixed is scored at its worst end; no penalty for disagreement itself

contrasts.name: Compounding pairs (06 items 1-4) versus same-size controls
A pace gap versus the same gap on autonomy
contrasts.default_at_stake: pace.mag, the largest penalty (07: needs evidence before launch)

contrasts.name: An innovation gap (either direction) versus the same gap on autonomy
Job more inventing than wanted versus job more refining than wanted
contrasts.default_at_stake: innovation.dir = 0, elicited 5 v 5 (07: needs evidence before launch); a is always the more-inventing side, so a tie is broken the same way in both
